label: Enable remote access
help: Off by default. While off, no request reaches HubSpot and the wallet is never read.

label: Access token secret
help: Wallet reference holding a HubSpot private app access token, or JSON with token. Never the token itself.

label: Object
help: Default CRM object. A request may name another one; the watch always follows this one.

label: Default operation
help: Used when a request gives no operation. Write operations need Allow writes.

label: Operations a request may choose
help: JSON array among ["search", "get", "create", "update", "upsert", "associate", "archive", "list_properties", "watch"]. The default operation is always allowed.

label: Properties to return
help: JSON array of internal property names, for example ["email", "firstname"]. Empty returns HubSpot's default properties. Run list_properties to discover custom ones.

label: Records per search (max)
help: Upper bound for one search; a request max_records can only lower it. HubSpot stops search paging at 10,000.

label: Allow writes
help: Off by default. Required for create, update, upsert, associate and archive.

label: Upsert key property
help: Unique property that identifies a record for upsert, such as email for contacts. A request may give its own. Suggestions list standard names only.

label: Records per write (max)
help: Larger requests are refused before any request. Inputs are sent in batches of 100.

label: Allow archive
help: Separate switch for archive. HubSpot moves archived records to its recycle bin, where they can be restored for 90 days.

label: Watch changed records
help: In Active Runtime, poll records of the object modified since the stored cursor and emit them on changed. One Shot polls once per watch request.

label: Poll interval (s)
help: At least 60 seconds between two polls of the Run listener.

label: Emit recent changes on first start
help: Off: the first start only records the current position. On: records modified in the window below are emitted once, in bounded polls.

label: Recent window (hours)
help: How far back the first start looks when Emit recent changes is on.

label: Changes per poll (max)
help: More changes wait for the next poll; none is skipped.

label: Records per page
help: limit sent to the HubSpot search API, at most 200. A request may lower it.

label: Pages per search (max)
help: Pages per search or watch poll; when reached, the result gives after to continue.

label: Operation deadline (s)
help: Total time for one request or poll, pages, batches, pacing and retries included.

label: Requests per 10 s (max)
help: Pacing per access token for this process. Private apps get 100 or more per 10 seconds depending on the plan.

label: Searches per second (max)
help: Separate pacing for search requests, which HubSpot limits to a few per second per account.

label: Retries
help: Reads retry after HTTP 429, 5xx or a lost connection; writes only after HTTP 429. The daily limit is never retried.

label: Longest retry wait (s)
help: A Retry-After or limit window above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting.

label: Request size limit (bytes)
help: Bound for the incoming request and for each JSON body sent to HubSpot.

label: Response size limit (bytes)
help: Larger HubSpot responses are refused as protocol errors.

label: HubSpot API origin
help: Keep https://api.hubapi.com. Another origin receives the token; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.

label: Custom CA file
help: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
